title: The Story of Getting Lost One Minute
youtube_title: The Story of Getting Lost One Minute | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: The best answer sometimes starts with hearing the whole thing.
summary: At a bedroom at lamp time, story not started yet, Auntie Luz begins to tell Ines about an one-minute story of feeling lost in a kind store. Ines wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
